If the text length exceeds the width and the position is equal to the next line tab stop, the position is adjusted to the width, potentially causing the loop to continue endlessly.

This code logic can result in the reported issue of an infinite loop when there is insufficient space to display a word on a single line, ultimately leading to an `OutOfMemoryError`.
